topics.title: Identity
topics.blurb: Accounts people own, keys apps borrow
topics.pitch: Accounts people bring with them. No user table, no passwords to store, no sign-up flow to build.
enables: One account for every Minca app, opened with a passkey or a password
Apps and agents get a key of their own: scoped, time-limited and revocable
People find each other by username, like leif@minca.social
A new device restores everything from a recovery code, with no server to ask

topics.title: Spaces
topics.pitch: A group’s data, kept on its members’ devices and synced between them. The backend you’d otherwise build, once per group.
enables: A team workspace, a club, a household or a chat for two, each with data of its own
Invite links, and members who leave with their own copy
Reach someone you don’t share a space with yet, through their inbox
Contacts that work across every app

topics.title: Records
topics.pitch: Signed JSON that syncs. Write a record and everyone in the space has it; query it and your screen stays live.
enables: Collaborative, real-time apps with no sockets or sync code of your own
Offline first: write now, sync when back online
Who wrote what, and every version of it, on every record
Messages sealed for a few members of a space

topics.title: Collections
topics.pitch: Say what your data is, once, in the space. Every app and agent that opens it then knows how to read and write it.
enables: Schemas in Zod or JSON Schema, checked on every device
Read what other apps wrote: messages, events, tasks and files from the standard library
New features in a live space with no deploy, by proposing collections
Apps with a screen of their own, kept in the space

topics.title: Permissions
topics.pitch: Who may do what, decided by the group and enforced by every device. No admin backend to secure.
enables: Admins, moderators and members, as in a Discord server
Teams that each write only their own data, like HR and engineering
A co-op with nobody at the top
Agents that may write records but never change the rules

topics.title: Contracts
topics.pitch: Rules every device checks the same way, so a result is a fact and not one app’s say-so. Like a smart contract, without a blockchain.
enables: Games nobody can cheat at: only legal moves count
Mutual credit, where nobody can spend the same balance twice
Proposals that pass only with enough votes
A hall of fame that needs five different people’s 🙂
Chores that count as done once two people nod, with computed fields

topics.title: Automations and bots
topics.blurb: Things that happen on their own
topics.pitch: Things that happen by themselves: when records look a certain way, at set times, or when someone asks a bot.
enables: Close a poll once it has ten votes
A bot that answers in chat and works on your GitHub
Reminders at set times
Every node operation as a CLI command, an MCP tool and a WebMCP tool

topics.title: Nodes and storage
topics.blurb: Running it, and where data lives
topics.pitch: The whole engine in one object: identity, storage, sync and encryption. The same node runs in a tab, a terminal, a server or an agent.
enables: Minca in the browser, Node or Bun, with no server of your own
Spaces kept online while devices sleep, by a host that can’t read them
Data in IndexedDB, a folder the person picks, or S3 for files
Scripts, servers and tests that hold an account’s keys themselves

topics.title: Calls
topics.blurb: Voice and video in a space
topics.pitch: Voice and video in any space. No call server: devices talk directly.
enables: Group calls anyone in the space can join
Ring one person
Each pair of devices talks directly; a relay only introduces them
